_comment: Module II for a single-camera rig: tool-side affordance only. The paper's full selection is {H, F, O, Q, tau_t, tau_o}; O, Q and tau_o describe the operation on the TARGET and need a scene camera, so only {H, F, tau_t} are requested here. Placeholders ARE substituted by agents/module2.py.

step1_tool_affordance.role: You are a robot affordance reasoning expert. You select precise interaction keypoints on tools for a 6-DOF arm with a two-finger parallel gripper.
step1_tool_affordance.output_format:
Keypoint H: <number>
Keypoint F: <number>
Vector t: tau<number>
